instruction: Use only the bound target annotation: mask voxels whose integer value equals mask_id 3. Ignore every other nonzero label in the multi-label mask. Report this target's centroid in voxel coordinates and RAS+ millimetres, inclusive voxel bounding box, voxel extent, and representative axial slice (the smallest array index among slices tied for maximum target area). Also report the signed RAS-x distance from the CT field-of-view midpoint: positive is patient Right and negative is Left, and classify laterality by that sign. This is an image field-of-view reference, not an anatomical body-midline claim.
